method: All 29,222 active edges structurally checked. This agent individually read 3,000 synonym pairs, all 759 antonyms, all 5,684 topic pairs, 3,660 root pairs and all 87 orthographic-ending pairs. A further 375 root pairs were checked against one explicit affix/template-argument mechanism; 10,217 remaining root pairs were validated through reviewed-family evidence and compound isolation. Original source and print-extraction checks targeted disputed senses. This is model/editorial research, not professional human lexicographic certification. Other synonym ranges are deliberately left to separately assigned audit files.
